data.title: 西连寺春菜 · 夕阳更衣室的慌乱心跳
data.action: 背靠金属更衣柜，双前臂护在身前挡住衬衫衣襟，满面通红惊慌抬眼
data.camera: front view, eye level, medium shot
data.lighting: 高处百叶窗透入的暖红夕阳余晖在身上投下横向光栅
data.location: 彩南高校女子更衣室金属储物柜旁
data.description: 放学后安静的更衣室内，夕阳透过高处百叶窗在地板与柜门上映出长长的光栅。春菜换衣中途被意外推门声惊吓，后背紧贴着储物柜，双臂慌乱护在胸前，整张脸通红，眼中满是无措的泪花。
data.promptProse: Backed against an open metal locker in the quiet locker room at sunset, Haruna Sairenji presses both forearms defensively across her unbuttoned white sailor blouse with teal collar above her teal pleated miniskirt. Looking toward the viewer at the doorway with flushed cheeks and embarrassed teary eyes, she is striped by warm crimson sunlight through slatted blinds.
data.nsfwProse: Her short-sleeved white sailor blouse with teal collar is undone at the front as she presses both forearms across her chest above her teal pleated miniskirt.
data.animaCaption: Backed against a slightly ajar metal locker with both forearms pressed modestly across her undone white sailor blouse, she looks toward the doorway with a bright, tearful blush. Warm sunset rays cast crisp horizontal blind stripes across the dim locker room.
